content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue with my INSYS GSM device, which is not communicating with my [product_name]. I tried various troubleshooting steps. When I send an alarm input to INSYS, it responds as expected, but when I connect it to [product_name] and run the program, the INSYS device does not reply. The RX/TX LEDs do not flash. I also sent a 'STATUS?' SMS to INSYS, which caused a brief blink on the RX/TX LED and three blinks on the Status LED, but I did not receive any reply. Checking the device history shows a 'GSM ERROR'. My [product_name] has part number [article_no], and my PC cable for [product_name] has part number [article_no]. Please review the attached INSYS configuration settings.

Hello [user_name], 1. It seems that the PLC data (.gsp file) was not loaded. Ask INSYS for the appropriate data for your [product_name] or locate it on your installation CD, then load it to your configuration via HSComm GSM > PLC > Load PLC Data. 2. Ensure that your [product_name] version ([article_no]) is compatible with INSYS GSM by confirming with the manufacturer.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered difficulties establishing communication between their [product_name] and an INSYS GSM device. The connection issue is indicated by a GSM error and lack of expected status response, with only brief LED indication. Another participant suggested potential configuration problems, emphasized loading the proper PLC data file, and advised checking compatibility between the specific [product_name] version and INSYS GSM.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable communication and responsiveness between INSYS GSM and [product_name], including correct status indicators and confirmed compatibility.
